security_audit.summary: Most static findings are Markdown code fences, documentation links, or local LibreOffice examples rather than hidden execution. The remaining risks are the troubleshooting commands that kill LibreOffice processes, open a localhost UNO socket, and reference one plain HTTP documentation URL.

remediation.issue: Troubleshooting commands can kill running LibreOffice processes and start a local UNO socket.
remediation.suggestion: Add explicit confirmation guidance, explain when the socket is needed, and include shutdown steps after automation finishes.

remediation.issue: The ezodf documentation reference uses a plain HTTP URL.
remediation.suggestion: Replace it with an HTTPS URL or remove the link if no secure source is available.

remediation.issue: Shell examples can modify files in the current directory.
remediation.suggestion: Recommend backups, test directories, and review of wildcard batch conversion before running commands.

content.value_statement: Spreadsheet workflows often need reliable file conversion and repeatable data setup. This skill guides Claude, Codex, and Claude Code through LibreOffice Calc creation, conversion, formulas, and automation.
actual_capabilities: Create new ODS spreadsheet workflows using LibreOffice Calc, UNO, or ezodf examples.
Convert between ODS, XLSX, CSV, PDF, HTML, and related spreadsheet formats.
Add formulas and basic calculations through LibreOffice UNO examples.
Outline batch conversion steps using headless LibreOffice commands.
Provide troubleshooting guidance for local LibreOffice UNO socket setup.
limitations: Requires LibreOffice or selected Python libraries to be installed before examples work.
Does not include ready-made scripts, templates, or packaged automation files.
API and database imports are mentioned, but detailed connection workflows are not provided.
Some commands can change files or running office processes and require review.

use_cases.title: Build Department Reports
use_cases.description: Create recurring ODS reports with formulas, totals, formatting, and export steps for sharing.

use_cases.title: Convert Client Files
use_cases.description: Plan safe conversion between ODS, XLSX, CSV, and PDF formats while preserving source files.

use_cases.title: Automate Spreadsheet Setup
use_cases.description: Use UNO or ezodf examples to design repeatable spreadsheet creation and formula workflows.

prompt_templates.title: Create a Basic Spreadsheet
prompt_templates.prompt: Create an ODS spreadsheet plan for a monthly budget. Include income, expenses, totals, and clear formatting.

prompt_templates.prompt: Convert an ODS file to XLSX and PDF. Explain the LibreOffice command steps and backup checks.

prompt_templates.title: Automate Formulas and Validation
prompt_templates.prompt: Design a Calc workbook for sales tracking. Include formulas, input validation, conditional formatting, and a summary sheet.

prompt_templates.title: Build a Batch Workflow
prompt_templates.prompt: Plan a batch workflow that converts spreadsheets, validates results, logs failures, and avoids overwriting source files.

output_examples.input: Create an ODS budget workbook for a small team.

output_examples.input: Convert a set of ODS reports to XLSX and PDF.
output_examples.output: A step-by-step conversion plan that checks backups, uses LibreOffice headless mode, and verifies exported files.

output_examples.input: Automate formulas for a sales report.
output: A proposed sheet layout with calculated totals.
Recommended validation rules for key inputs.
A summary of formatting and review steps.

best_practices: Review shell commands before running them on real files.
Keep source spreadsheets and backups before conversion.
Use sample files to test formulas and exports first.
anti_patterns: Running commands against broad file patterns without checking the directory.
Opening a local automation socket longer than needed.
Assuming format conversion preserves every formula or chart exactly.

faq.question: Does this skill create spreadsheets directly?
faq.answer: It provides guidance and examples for creating spreadsheets with LibreOffice Calc, UNO, and ODS libraries.

faq.question: Does it require LibreOffice?
faq.answer: LibreOffice is required for soffice commands and UNO automation. Python library examples require separate package installation.

faq.question: Can it convert XLSX and CSV?
faq.answer: Yes. It describes conversions among ODS, XLSX, XLS, CSV, PDF, HTML, and related formats.

faq.question: Does it run commands automatically?
faq.answer: No. The skill contains command examples that an agent or user must review before execution.

faq.question: Is it safe for sensitive spreadsheets?
faq.answer: Use local files, avoid unnecessary network access, and review commands before processing sensitive data.

faq.question: Can it build complex reports?
faq.answer: It can guide formulas, summaries, validation, formatting, and dashboards, but advanced macros need extra review.
